# Data

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# samples
sp <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv"))

# objects 
obj <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_objects_morpho_taxo_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  left_join(select(sp,sampleid,acquisid,d)) # %>%
```

Note that the zoopath and morphological space requires to have access to the images, and is thus not included in here.

# Transparency and size

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Global correlations

```{r}
pearson_test <- psych::corr.test(obj[, morph_cols], method = "pearson")
spearman_test <- psych::corr.test(obj[, morph_cols], method = "spearman")


# pearson
heatmaply_cor(
  cor(as.matrix(obj[,9:39]),method="pearson"),
  xlab = "Features",
  ylab = "Features",
  grid_color="white"
) 

# spearman
heatmaply_cor(
  cor(as.matrix(obj[,9:39]),method="spearman"),
  xlab = "Features",
  ylab = "Features",
  grid_color="white",
  show_dendrogram = c(FALSE,TRUE)     # Remove column dendrogram and keep row dendrogram
) 
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(cfg$project$figures,"FigSX_spearman_correlation.tiff"),dpi=300,width=8,height=6.5)
```

## Area vs. grey median per taxonomic classes

```{r}
# per taxonomic class
correlations <- obj %>%
  group_by(class_phylum) %>%
  summarize(correlation = cor(grey_median, size_area, method = "spearman"),
            n=n()) 

# plot
ggplot(correlations, aes(x = reorder(class_phylum, correlation), y = correlation)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = correlation), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # Taxonomic group names next to bar
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = class_phylum,
      hjust = ifelse(correlation > 0, -0.1, 1.1)
    ),
    size = 3.2
  ) +

  # Right-aligned `n` at far right
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = reorder(class_phylum, correlation),
      y = 0.8,  # move farther right if needed
      label = paste0(n, " images")
    ),
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +

  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Spearman correlation coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 70, 10, 10)  # add more right margin
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 0.8),  # expand past the max bar
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(cfg$project$figures,"FigSX_size_regression_taxo.tiff"),dpi=300,width=8,height=5.5)
```

# Morphological variation

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Values are transformed with Yeo-Johnson for normality before the PCAs:

```{r}
obj.mat=select(obj,objid,grey_mean:shape_perimferet) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var="objid") %>% 
  mutate_all(~predict(yeojohnson(.)))
```

## PCA: all variables

Weighted principal component analysis:

```{r}
morpho.pca <- PCA(obj.mat,graph=FALSE,row.w=obj$d)
```

Contributions of the 4 first axis:

```{r}
morpho.pca[["eig"]][1:4,2]
```

Top 5 contributors to axis 1 and axis 2:

```{r}
# pc1
sort(morpho.pca[["var"]][["contrib"]][,1],decreasing=TRUE) %>% head(10)
# pc2
sort(morpho.pca[["var"]][["contrib"]][,2],decreasing=TRUE) %>% head(10)
```

Morphospace visualization: there are 533 images over the 572856 for which we do not have the jpg file associated, so these are removed or risk making the code fail.

```{r}
# remove absent images
missing_files=file.exists(obj$path)
table(missing_files)
obj.mat <- obj.mat[missing_files==TRUE,]
d=obj$d[missing_files==TRUE]

# pca
set.seed(123)
pca <- morphospace(obj.mat,weights=d)

# Stock descriptors scores
descriptors_scores = as.data.frame(pca$var$coord)
descriptors_scores <- rownames_to_column(descriptors_scores, "descriptors")

# Add contributions
descriptors_scores$Contrib12 = pca$var$contrib[,c(1)] + pca$var$contrib[,c(2)]
descriptors_scores$Contrib34 = pca$var$contrib[,c(3)] + pca$var$contrib[,c(4)]

# add cos2
descriptors_scores$cos12 = pca$var$cos2[,c(1)] + pca$var$cos2[,c(2)]
descriptors_scores$cos34 = pca$var$cos2[,c(3)] + pca$var$cos2[,c(4)]

# Plot objects on the two plan of the morphological space  :
# First plan of morphological space (axes 1 and 2)
# ggmorph_tile is the function that take path of images to plot them on the PCA (you can choose the numer of cells, the number of images you pick and the scale of image representation)

set.seed(224)
a <- ggmorph_tile(pca, obj$path[missing_files==TRUE],fun=function(x) img_chop(x,b=31), steps=11, n_imgs=8, scale=0.007)+
  # only the descriptors with cos2 > 0.9
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Dim.1*5, yend = Dim.2*5), size = 0.5, alpha= 0.9, arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.2,"cm")), data =filter(descriptors_scores,cos12 > 0.69)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = Dim.1*5, y = Dim.2*5, label = descriptors, size = Contrib12), fontface =1, alpha = 1, segment.alpha = 0.2, data=filter(descriptors_scores,cos12 > 0.69))+
  theme_bw(base_size=12)+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  scale_size(range=c(3, 6))
plot(a)
```

```{r}
ggsave("../figures/Fig3a_PCA_all.tiff",dpi=300,width=7,height=6)
```

## PCA: transparency variables

```{r}
obj.mat=select(obj.mat,starts_with("grey")) 

# pca
```

```{r}
# pca
set.seed(123)
pca <- morphospace(obj.mat,weights=d)

# Stock descriptors scores
descriptors_scores = as.data.frame(pca$var$coord)
descriptors_scores <- rownames_to_column(descriptors_scores, "descriptors")

# Add contributions
descriptors_scores$Contrib12 = pca$var$contrib[,c(1)] + pca$var$contrib[,c(2)]
descriptors_scores$Contrib34 = pca$var$contrib[,c(3)] + pca$var$contrib[,c(4)]

# add cos2
descriptors_scores$cos12 = pca$var$cos2[,c(1)] + pca$var$cos2[,c(2)]
descriptors_scores$cos34 = pca$var$cos2[,c(3)] + pca$var$cos2[,c(4)]

# Plot objects on the two plan of the morphological space  :
# First plan of morphological space (axes 1 and 2)
# ggmorph_tile is the function that take path of images to plot them on the PCA (you can choose the numer of cells, the number of images you pick and the scale of image representation)

set.seed(224)
a <- ggmorph_tile(pca, obj$path[missing_files==TRUE],fun=function(x) img_chop(x,b=31), steps=11, n_imgs=8, scale=0.007)+
  # only the descriptors with cos2 > 0.9
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Dim.1*5, yend = Dim.2*5), size = 0.5, alpha= 0.9, arrow=arrow(length=unit(0.2,"cm")), data =filter(descriptors_scores,cos12 > 0.7)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = Dim.1*5, y = Dim.2*5, label = descriptors, size = Contrib12), fontface =1, alpha = 1, segment.alpha = 0.2, data=filter(descriptors_scores,cos12 > 0.7))+
  theme_bw(base_size=12)+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  scale_size(range=c(3, 6))
plot(a)
```
